summary: Dark City Poets Society is a real, named poetry group founded in January 2020 by Clint Bowman with Black Mountain Library branch manager Melisa Pressley, taking its name from an old nickname for Black Mountain. It runs a monthly critique/feedback meeting at the Black Mountain Library plus a monthly public reading (currently on the patio/still room of Oak and Grist Distilling Company, the venue in this listing), drawing a consistent core of regular contributing poets alongside open community participation.

evidence.note: Our State magazine profile: founded 2020 by Clint Bowman and Melisa Pressley, holds monthly critique sessions plus monthly open readings, has a consistent core of regular attendees (names a real-estate agent who contributes work monthly), and posts on Instagram @darkcitypoetssociety.

Black Mountain News: group does a monthly critique meeting and a monthly reading, with monthly readings at Oak and Grist Distilling Company drawing crowds of ~60, framed as continuing Black Mountain College's literary tradition.

Search results also surface a separate 'Dark City Poets Society Feedback Group' listing at Buncombe County Public Libraries, confirming the group runs its own distinct recurring meeting beyond this one venue's reading night.

Listing tags include 'Open Mic' and 'rotating readers'/'rotating lineup of local voices', consistent with the group's stated model of a rotating cast of contributing poets built around a persistent organizing group and named founders, not just a venue's open-mic night.
